title: Protection Adjustment to the Young-Driver Surcharge Rate on a Keyturn Trip Booking
content:
Where the guest has taken cover of the higher sort on a Keyturn Trip Booking, percentage points come off the young-driver surcharge rate. The election is made under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan, and what is read is the level the election is written as, whether it stands active, and the daily protection fees charged on it.

| The protection election standing on the trip | Protection adjustment (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| Stands active, written as Keyturn Premier Protection or as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, and the daily protection fees charged on it come to 800.00 USD or more, however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised | -4 |
| Stands active, written as Keyturn Premier Protection or as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection, and the daily protection fees charged on it come to less than 800.00 USD | -2 |
| Any other case | 0 |

A figure of -4 percentage points is 4 percentage points off the rate, and -2 percentage points is 2 percentage points off it.

### Which fees are counted

The fees counted are the daily protection fee lines raised on that election and those alone; a line raised on it for anything else — a young-driver protection surcharge, a level-change difference, an additional-driver fee, a deductible or a credit — is not a daily protection fee and is not counted.

The daily protection fee lines are counted however many lines they stand as and whenever they were raised, so several such lines raised on different days are added together and none of them is too old to count.

### Reading the conditions

Each of the first two rows is a conjunction of three limbs: the election stands active; it is written as one of the two named levels; and the daily protection fees fall on one side or the other of 800.00 USD. All three must hold. An election written as Keyturn Standard Protection makes no adjustment however large its fees, and an election written as Keyturn Premier Protection that has ceased to stand active makes none either.

The fee figure is reached rather than passed: daily protection fees of exactly 800.00 USD put the election in the first row and give 4 percentage points off.

*Hypothetical.* An active election written as Keyturn Business Traveler Protection carrying 1150.00 USD of daily protection fees gives an adjustment of -4 percentage points. The same election carrying 640.00 USD of daily protection fees gives -2 percentage points, and it still gives -2 percentage points where a further 300.00 USD stands on it as an additional-driver fee, since that line is not a daily protection fee. An active election written as Keyturn Advantage Protection carrying 1150.00 USD of daily protection fees gives 0.
